CLINICAL STUDY REPORT — EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Moderna, Inc. | mRNA-1273-P301

Study ID: mRNA-1273-P301
Study Name: COVE Study
Phase: Phase 3
Title: Prevention of COVID-19 in Adults 18+
Study Period: 13 December 2023 to 03 April 2026
Number of Subjects: 30420
Study Sites: 168 sites across United States
IND Number: IND-1672-67
Report Date: 16 October 2026
Medical Monitor: Joyce Rice, MD, PhD
1. Synopsis
This Clinical Study Report summarizes the results of COVE Study (mRNA-1273-P301), a Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating the safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy of mRNA-1273 in 30,420 participants. The study was conducted in accordance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
2. Study Design
Design: Randomized, Observer-Blinded, Placebo-Controlled
Randomization Ratio: 1:1 (Vaccine:Placebo)
Dosing Schedule: Two doses (Day 1 and Day 29)
Dose: 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection)
Follow-up Period: 24 months post-dose 2

4. Safety Summary
The vaccine demonstrated an acceptable safety profile. The most common solicited adverse events were injection site pain (90%), fatigue (67%), headache (60%), and myalgia (56%). The majority of adverse events were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days. Serious adverse events (SAEs) occurred in 0.9% of vaccine recipients vs 1.2% of placebo recipients. No vaccine-related SAEs led to death.
5. Immunogenicity Summary
mRNA-1273 induced robust and durable neutralizing antibody responses. Geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 were 1699 (95% CI: 834 – 2335). Seroconversion rates were 99.2% at 28 days post-dose 2. T-cell responses (CD4+ and CD8+) were also observed in a subset analysis.
6. Conclusions
mRNA-1273 demonstrated 94.3% efficacy against COVID-19 and an acceptable safety profile consistent with other approved vaccines. These results support the benefit-risk assessment for regulatory approval in the indicated population.
